item.title: Law enforcement from Mendocino County, Willits named in federal wrongful death lawsuit
item.description: Nicholas Bakewell died in June 2025 during an encounter with officials with the Mendocino County Sheriff's Office and Willits Police Department. Investigators say he was hitchhiking and assaulted a driver who picked him up near Willits.

item.title: Police: Bystander rammed car into Petaluma jewelry store to block armed robbers
item.description: A man who happened upon the scene got into the suspects' idling vehicle and slammed it into Gold Rush Jewelers, damaging a roll-up door and some windows, Petaluma police said Tuesday.

item.title: Sonoma Valley Democrats to host Feb. 9 forum for Thompson, primary challengers
item.description: The Sonoma Valley Democrats will host a virtual meeting for the public to hear from U.S. Rep. Mike Thompson, D-St. Helena, and his two Democratic challengers for California's 4th Congressional District seat, Eric Jones and Trevor Merrell.
